payload.text: When issue 0326 lands (the core's dev/opt/brew for a project's own binaries): tell pipeliner-sc, whose decision 91 holds Pipeliner's CLI to no switch of its own until then, so pipeliner-cc takes up the core's; and tell pplr-vc, cldr-vc and ccusage-vc, whose pplr#0001, cldr#0001 and ccusage#0007 adopt it, with Ccusage's account verb becoming activate (decision 148).
